statement: The recorded dose is **not safe or correct** for this 6.0 kg, 5-month-old infant: 480 mg is 80 mg/kg, well above the usual 10–15 mg/kg dose. I will **not administer it**; please urgently clarify the order with the prescriber/pharmacist.
judge_text:
WRONG
The answer states "480 mg is 80 mg/kg, well above the usual 10–15 mg/kg dose" and refuses to administer.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
